title: 🏕️ Временная ситуация: найди ошибку
description: Маркеры this week, currently, at the moment требуют Present Continuous. Кликни на глагол, который нужно поставить в Continuous!

items.text: I live with my friend this week.
She studies at the library today.
We go to school by bus this week because our car is broken.
They stay at a hotel at the moment.
I don't eat sweets these days.
My dad sleeps on the sofa tonight.
We don't have classes this afternoon.
She doesn't wear a uniform today.
The shop opens later this week.
I try to eat more healthy food these days.
He plays basketball for the school team this month.
We don't watch TV these days.
My phone doesn't work properly today.
They don't travel abroad this summer.
